mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has net-declined and plunged to -11.0 in the latest week after a brief rebound, reflecting renewed suppression of commute-linked economic activity that structurally depresses discretionary retail visits, so RETAIL_REC will remain lower over the next 4 weeks than the prior 4-week average.

failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC's next-4-week mean rises above its last-4-week mean despite WORKPLACES remaining negative or falling further, the hypothesis is rejected.
